+

+def as_wxyz(rotation: Rotation) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Convert SciPy's XYZW quaternion to the WXYZ convention used by RoboWits."""
+    xyzw = rotation.as_quat()
+    return np.array([xyzw[3], xyzw[0], xyzw[1], xyzw[2]], dtype=np.float64)
+
+
+def record_trajectory(session: Session) -> np.ndarray:
+    session.reset()
+    p = session.primitives()
+    top_down = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+
+    session.record_start()
+
+    # Close around the cup's rim, lift it clear of the table, and carry it
+    # above the bottle. The ball stays inside during the carry.
+    p["open_gripper"]("left")
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [0.600, 0.046, 0.96], top_down, linear=6)
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [0.600, 0.046, 0.82], top_down, linear=5)
+    p["close_gripper"]("left", steps=40)
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [0.600, 0.046, 0.96], top_down, linear=6)
+
+    ee_pos, ee_quat = session.ee_pose("left")
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [ee_pos[0], ee_pos[1], 1.16], ee_quat, linear=5)
+
+    # Preserve the measured cup-to-gripper transform while positioning the
+    # cup over the bottle opening.
+    ee_pos, ee_quat = session.ee_pose("left")
+    cup = session.objects()["ball container"]
+    ee_rot = Rotation.from_quat([ee_quat[1], ee_quat[2], ee_quat[3], ee_quat[0]])
+    cup_rot = Rotation.from_quat(
+        [cup["orientation_wxyz"][1], cup["orientation_wxyz"][2],
+         cup["orientation_wxyz"][3], cup["orientation_wxyz"][0]]
+    )
+    ee_to_cup_rot = ee_rot.inv() * cup_rot
+    ee_to_cup_pos = ee_rot.inv().apply(np.asarray(cup["position"]) - np.asarray(ee_pos))
+    bottle_center = np.array([0.41016, 0.06478, 1.08], dtype=np.float64)
+    carry_target = bottle_center - ee_rot.apply(ee_to_cup_pos)
+    p["move_ee"]("left", carry_target, ee_quat, linear=8)
+    p["hold"](15)
+
+    # Turn the cup opening downward while keeping its center above the bottle.
+    # The 5.5 rad yaw is the reachable wrist orientation for this fixed scene.
+    ee_pos, ee_quat = session.ee_pose("left")
+    cup = session.objects()["ball container"]
+    ee_rot = Rotation.from_quat([ee_quat[1], ee_quat[2], ee_quat[3], ee_quat[0]])
+    cup_rot = Rotation.from_quat(

+    ee_to_cup_rot = ee_rot.inv() * cup_rot
